notable_absence.finding: Both the Capella and Server prerequisite call-outs recommend a broad administrative role for getting-started purposes ('Organization Owner' / 'Full Admin') while explicitly warning against this for production ('Couchbase strongly recommends setting up users with more granular access roles as a best practice for data security') - a documented tutorial-vs-production tension worth surfacing, though it does not name which more-granular role a production app should use instead, only gesturing at 'the Security documentation' generically.

cross_component_finding: This page repeats the exact same canonical KV upsert-with-durability code snippet used verbatim on hello-world/overview.md ('collection.upsert("my-document", JsonObject.create().put("doc", true), upsertOptions().durability(DurabilityLevel.MAJORITY));'), confirming the two pages are deliberately kept in sync on their shared first example rather than drifting.
cross_product_finding: The page's 'Before You Start' / 'Prerequisites' / 'Connect to your Database' sections all carry parallel Capella-vs-self-managed-Server tab content throughout (separate bullet lists, separate role call-outs, separate connection-string code blocks for `couchbases://<capella-endpoint>` vs `couchbase://127.0.0.1`), making this one of the clearest examples in the batch of a single tutorial page maintaining two fully parallel product tracks rather than treating Capella as a variant/footnote of Server.
